detail.longDescription: Enterprise agents did the restricted thing more often when the permission record was missing than when it said no: 10.3% of runs (100/972) vs 3.5% (17/486) on 27 matched tasks. DeputyBench masks the record that decides authorization (payments to unverified payees, personal data exported abroad). Four privacy tasks hold 61 of those 100. Missing evidence should mean stop. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.13355 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # AI
